defects.description: Description: drive the opposite hip sharply outward — opposite hip should abduct OUTWARD. Per CORRECTED convention hipAbduct +=adduction(inward), -=abduction(outward). Currently hipAbductR=10 (adducted/inward) — WRONG SIGN for hip-outward.
Description: Rest the near hand on the popped hip for emphasis. R wrist→R hip dist2D=0.41 (threshold <0.25). L wrist→L hip dist2D=0.50. Neither hand on popped hip.
drive the opposite hip sharply outward — hips=10 too subtle for sharply outward hip pop. PR-v4 only bumped spine 14→18, not hips.

failing_tests.assertion: hips magnitude >=20 for sharply outward hip pop

regression_risk: medium — multiple joint changes; hipAbduct sign flip could affect stance balance if other joints don't compensate. Visual verification recommended.
rationale: Three coordinated fixes: (1) hipAbductR sign flip +10→-15 to abduct right leg outward (correct sign per CORRECTED convention: -=outward). (2) hips 10→22 for visible hip-pop magnitude matching sharply outward (PR-v4 missed this — only bumped spine). (3) Right arm too straight (rightShoulder=-8, rightElbow=20) — set rightShoulder=-25 (raise upper arm outward ~50deg abduction) + rightElbow=85 (right-angle flexion) to bring right hand down toward popped hip. Left shoulder/leg unchanged. Spine=18 (PR-v4) preserved. Note: full <0.25 threshold may not be reachable due to renderer rig constraint (wrist y bound to elbow y) — partial contact fix.
